svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: POUR: WCAG's four principles, what goes wrong under each, and what to do
svg.desc: Perceivable fails on informative images with no alt text and body copy that vanishes in daylight; fix with text alternatives, captions, adaptable structure and real contrast. Operable fails on click-here links and hover-only menus; fix with full keyboard operation, visible focus, 24 by 24 pixel targets and no drag-only actions. Understandable fails on undefined jargon and errors shown only as a red border; fix with plain language, a declared document language, predictable pages and labelled fields. Robust fails on custom controls built from unlabelled generic elements; fix with native elements and correct roles, names and values.
svg.text: WCAG’S FOUR PRINCIPLES, SHORTENED TO POUR
WHAT GOES WRONG
WHAT TO DO
P
Perceivable
An informative image with no alt text.Body copy that vanishes in daylight.
Text alternatives, captions, adaptablestructure, and real contrast.
O
Operable
A link that only says “click here”.A menu that opens only on hover.
Full keyboard operation, visible focus,24 by 24px targets, no drag-only actions.
U
Understandable
Undefined jargon and acronyms.An error shown only as a red border.
Plain language, a declared documentlanguage, labelled fields, no surprises.
R
Robust
A custom control built from unlabelledgeneric elements.
Native elements where they exist; correctroles, names and values where they do not.
You cannot make something usable for a person who cannot reach it.
